description: This file is an HTML document that implements the user interface for a database visualizer or browser. It contains structure, styles, and client-side JavaScript to fetch and display database names, tables, and table data interactively.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Reloads the list of databases and resets the UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the display of tables for a selected database and initiates loading of tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data from a selected table and displays it in a tabular format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML to display table data, including handling wide content and rich data types.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content when a wide or object data cell is clicked.
